t: This is Kilburn Park, a London Underground station in the London Borough of Brent. It sits on the Bakerloo line between Queen's Park and Maida Vale, in fare zone 2. The station was designed by Stanley Heaps, an English architect who lived from 1880 to 1962. Heaps designed a number of stations across the Underground system, as well as train depots and bus and trolleybus garages for London Transport. So if you've used other stations of this kind, you may well have passed through his work before.
